spec.body_markdown: ## Cross Product\n\nThe cross product A x B is a vector perpendicular to both A and B, with magnitude |A||B|sin(theta) equal to the area of the parallelogram they form. Its direction follows the right-hand rule: curl your fingers from A to B, and your thumb points along A x B. Torque = Position x Force is a classic physics example.
